newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 28.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 28.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones fell 58.11 points to 6,925.07. PLDT's ADR dipped $0 1/2 to $59.
* The peso closed slid to 26.333 to a U.S. dollar from 26.332 on Wednesday.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange composite index dropped 15.87 points to 3,333.94.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average was unchanged at 10.5625 percent.
* Bankers Trust Asia Research says it expects the Philippines to get an investment grade credit rating before the year 2000. (MALAYA)
* Seafront Resources Corp says it will invest up to 100 million for the development of a mixed use complex in Bataan.
* Reynolds Philippines Corp closes at its initial public offering price of 4.55 pesos after falling to 4.05 pesos in early trade.
* Uniwide Holdings Inc subsidiary Uniwide Sales Realty and Resources Corp says it has entered into a joint venture with owners of a big parcel of land in Quezon province.
* Urban Bank Corp says its board has approved a resolution declaring a five peso cash dividend and a 15 percent stock dividend.
* San Miguel Corp sets a 10 percent stock dividend to shareholders as of May 15.
